subject.title: feat(nodes): continue Claude catalog sessions on paired nodes via streaming CLI agent runs

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this bounded v1 paired-node Claude execution design, including its new public plugin SDK, gateway protocol, session-placement, and node-host configuration contracts?
rationale: The implementation adds a strategically useful capability but also creates durable cross-layer contracts and a sensitive remote-execution surface; automated review cannot choose whether those permanent interfaces are the intended product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor bounded v1
options.body: Approve the proposed architecture after the spawn blocker is fixed and real paired-node behavior is proven, while keeping the documented exclusions as follow-up work.

options.title: Narrow public surfaces
options.body: Keep paired-node continuation but redesign unnecessary public SDK or generic protocol exposure as internal seams before merge.

options.title: Defer node agent runs
options.body: Leave paired-node catalog sessions view-only until the broader node agent-execution contract and platform support are designed together.

recommendation.title: Sponsor bounded v1
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed architecture after the spawn blocker is fixed and real paired-node behavior is proven, while keeping the documented exclusions as follow-up work.
